$ edit testdata/export/coded.txtar  # an export import rejects with a *codedError
$ FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test  # chain-codes
    The root-package check for the module-root corpus runs in normal runs, so it runs after the update: go test ./...
    export/coded: evaluate is blocked: the lift import failed on the case, and testdata/export/coded.txtar, out/import/error.txt, records its error.
    export/coded: list is blocked: the lift import failed on the case, and testdata/export/coded.txtar, out/import/error.txt, records its error.
    export/coded: parse is blocked: the lift import failed on the case, and testdata/export/coded.txtar, out/import/error.txt, records its error.
    export/coded: resolve is blocked: the lift import failed on the case, and testdata/export/coded.txtar, out/import/error.txt, records its error.
    export/coded/transform/louder: louder declines the base: the export makes no output of evaluate
    export/empty/transform/louder: louder declines the base: the export makes no output of evaluate
    export/looped: evaluate is blocked: the lift resolve failed on the case, and testdata/export/looped.txtar, out/resolve/error.txt, records its error.
    export/looped/transform/louder: louder declines the base: the base states circular, which louder neither gives nor keeps
    export/names/transform/louder: louder declines the base: the export makes no output of evaluate
    export/prices/variant/unclosed: evaluate is blocked: the lift import failed on the case, and testdata/export/prices.txtar, variant/unclosed/out/import/error.txt, records its error.
    export/prices/variant/unclosed: list is blocked: the lift import failed on the case, and testdata/export/prices.txtar, variant/unclosed/out/import/error.txt, records its error.
    export/prices/variant/unclosed: parse is blocked: the lift import failed on the case, and testdata/export/prices.txtar, variant/unclosed/out/import/error.txt, records its error.
    export/prices/variant/unclosed: resolve is blocked: the lift import failed on the case, and testdata/export/prices.txtar, variant/unclosed/out/import/error.txt, records its error.
    what ran, in order:
        import ran
        import ran
        parse ran on empty
        resolve ran on empty
        evaluate's probe ran
        evaluate ran on empty
        import ran
        parse ran on looped
        resolve ran on looped
        import ran
        parse ran on names
        resolve ran on names
        evaluate's probe ran
        evaluate ran on names
        import ran
        parse ran on prices
        resolve ran on prices
        evaluate's probe ran
        evaluate ran on prices
        import ran
        import ran
        parse ran on prices
        resolve ran on prices
        evaluate's probe ran
        evaluate ran on prices
        import ran
        parse ran on prices
        resolve ran on prices
        evaluate's probe ran
        evaluate ran on prices
        parse ran on plain
        resolve ran on plain
        evaluate's probe ran
        evaluate ran on plain

$ cat testdata/export/coded.txtar
import rejects the export with an error that has a code.
-- properties --
unterminated
-- in/import/coded --
C101
-- out/evaluate/outcome --
blocked import
-- out/import/error.txt --
import: an error with the code C101
-- out/import/inputs --
error.txt
-- out/import/outcome --
rejected C101
-- out/list/outcome --
blocked import
-- out/parse/outcome --
blocked import
-- out/resolve/outcome --
blocked import
$ go test  # chain-codes
    export/coded: evaluate is blocked: testdata/export/coded.txtar, out/import/outcome, records the lift import's outcome as "rejected C101".
    export/coded: list is blocked: testdata/export/coded.txtar, out/import/outcome, records the lift import's outcome as "rejected C101".
    export/coded: parse is blocked: testdata/export/coded.txtar, out/import/outcome, records the lift import's outcome as "rejected C101".
    export/coded: resolve is blocked: testdata/export/coded.txtar, out/import/outcome, records the lift import's outcome as "rejected C101".
    export/coded/transform/louder: louder declines the base: the export makes no output of evaluate
    export/empty/transform/louder: louder declines the base: the export makes no output of evaluate
    export/looped: evaluate is blocked: the lift resolve failed on the case, and testdata/export/looped.txtar, out/resolve/error.txt, records its error.
    export/looped/transform/louder: louder declines the base: the base states circular, which louder neither gives nor keeps
    export/names/transform/louder: louder declines the base: the export makes no output of evaluate
    export/prices/variant/unclosed: evaluate is blocked: testdata/export/prices.txtar, variant/unclosed/out/import/outcome, records the lift import's outcome as "rejected".
    export/prices/variant/unclosed: list is blocked: testdata/export/prices.txtar, variant/unclosed/out/import/outcome, records the lift import's outcome as "rejected".
    export/prices/variant/unclosed: parse is blocked: testdata/export/prices.txtar, variant/unclosed/out/import/outcome, records the lift import's outcome as "rejected".
    export/prices/variant/unclosed: resolve is blocked: testdata/export/prices.txtar, variant/unclosed/out/import/outcome, records the lift import's outcome as "rejected".
